name: [FPS] One Scope
desc:
One shot decides everything.

🔫 Sniper-only combat
🔪 Tactical knife eliminations
⚡ Clean movement & instant action

💎 Skins & Progression
🎰 Unlock unique rifle & knife skins through cases
💰 Earn in-game cash by getting kills and headshots
🏆 Limited skins
📦 Exclusive bundle rewards
👑 VIP XP boosts

Upgrade yourself. Unlock. Dominate.

PC🖥️
LMB: Shoot
RMB: Aim
Q/Mouse wheel/1 and 2 on numpad: Swap weapons
F/V: Inspect weapons
C: Slide


Controller 🎮
RT: Fire
LT: Aim
Y: Swap Weapons
B: Inspects 
X: Menu
L1/X: Slide


Mobile📱
Follow on-screen instructions

Inspired by [FPS] Flick, One Tap,  Pixel Gun 3D, Block Strike
